name: TX-07
label: Safe D

key_factors: Fletcher's massive financial advantage ($1.7M cash vs ~$6K)
Incumbency and no serious outside spending against her
Markets price Fletcher at ~96% to win
model.rationale: Fletcher holds a D+13 seat with a huge fundraising edge and no meaningful opposition spending, while Polymarket prices her near certain to win. With no polls or expert ratings available, fundamentals point to a comfortable double-digit incumbent win.
model.watch: A late surge of outside spending against Fletcher or an unusually strong Republican environment in Texas could narrow the margin.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Lizzie Fletcher seeks a fourth term in a Houston-area district that has trended firmly Democratic, with a partisan lean of about 13 points toward Democrats. She faces Republican Alexander Hale, a first-time candidate who has raised under $80,000 and has minimal cash on hand, plus a Green Party candidate with negligible resources.

Fletcher has raised over $1.4 million and holds $1.7 million on hand, giving her an overwhelming financial advantage. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give her roughly a 96% chance of winning. The fundamentals point to a safe Democratic hold with a margin in the low twenties.
